overview_description.description:
HYPE Innovation is a global leader in innovation ecosystem management software and services. With HYPE, organizations can engage employees, customers, and partners in strategy building, idea and partner management, and innovation project management. HYPE’s client community includes global companies such as Airbus, AkzoNobel, UNICEF, Deutsche Post DHL Group, Fujitsu, Mattel, Merck, Nokia, UCSD, and Siemens.

HYPE is headquartered in Bonn, Germany, and maintains major offices in the US and France, as well as minor offices spread across the globe.

product.name: HYPE Innovation Platform
product.description: A software platform that integrates strategy, ideation, and execution to manage the entire innovation lifecycle with AI-driven modules.

product.name: HYPE Trends & Tech
product.description: A module for identifying and analyzing critical market trends and emerging technologies to inform innovation strategy.

product.name: HYPE Partnering
product.description: A tool to identify, evaluate, and manage external partners, startups, and technologies for collaborative innovation.

product.name: HYPE Ideation
product.description: A module to run targeted ideation campaigns that generate, evaluate, and develop ideas aligned with business goals.

product.name: HYPE Startup Scouting
product.description: A solution to streamline the identification and engagement of high-potential startups for strategic collaboration.

product.name: HYPE Tech Scouting
product.description: A tool to discover and leverage emerging technologies ahead of competitors to maintain market relevance.
